MAPPLET.DESCRIPTION: Business Component for User Dimension that extracts the Users information such as Users Name,Email Address and so on from Oracle Apps tables FND_USER and PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F.
MAPPLET.NAME: mplt_BC_ORA_UserDimension

TABLEATTRIBUTE.NAME: Sql Query
TABLEATTRIBUTE.VALUE: SELECT A.USER_ID, A.USER_NAME, A.EMAIL_ADDRESS, A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE AS CHANGED_ON_DT, A.LAST_UPDATED_BY, A.CREATION_DATE, A.CREATED_BY, A.FAX , B.FIRST_NAME, B.MIDDLE_NAMES, B.LAST_NAME, B.FULL_NAME, (CASE WHEN B.CURRENT_EMPLOYEE_FLAG = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) CURRENT_EMPLOYEE_FLAG, B.PRE_NAME_ADJUNCT, B.SUFFIX , B.EFFECTIVE_START_DATE, B.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, B.SEX, '0' As X_Custom ,d.ledger_name,d.currency_code,d.business_group_name,d.operating_unit_name, b.global_name FROM FND_USER A, PER_ALL_PEOPLE_F B, (Select Person_Id, Max(Effective_Start_Date) Max_Eff_Start_Date From Per_All_People_F Group By Person_Id) C, (select org.*,gl_sets_of_books.name ledger_name, gl_sets_of_books.currency_code,busgrp.name business_group_name,ou.name operating_unit_name from (select distinct business_group_id,set_of_books_id,operating_unit operating_unit_id from org_organization_definitions) org,gl_sets_of_books, HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_TL busgrp,HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS_TL ou where org.set_of_books_id=gl_sets_of_books.set_of_books_id And Org.Business_Group_Id=Busgrp.Organization_Id And Org.Operating_Unit_Id=Ou.Organization_Id) D WHERE A.EMPLOYEE_ID = C.PERSON_ID (+) AND C.Person_Id = B.Person_Id (+) And C.Max_Eff_Start_Date = B.Effective_Start_Date (+) And B.business_group_id =d.business_group_id(+)AND ( A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE > TO_DATE('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') OR B.Last_Update_Date > To_Date('$$LAST_EXTRACT_DATE','MM/DD/YYYY HH24:MI:SS') )

MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: Extracts the user information from oracle apps into the staging area users table.The User dimension table contains information about users who created or modified records in the source system, from which the rows have been extracted. It has the contact and location information about the users. Since such a user can be potentially an Employee as well as Contractor, qualifying flags are also present in this table for informational purposes.
